reviews.comment: Professor Wadlington was incredible! I was required to take this class for Nursing and had 0 knowledge of philosophy or philosophical texts, but he worked with me and answered my 1000 emails. I asked him to cancel the class before spring break and he did! The lectures were boring, but the texts were interesting and I enjoyed writing his papers!

Professor Wadlington is a really good guy. He is understanding and is passionate about teaching. He grades fairly, and if you try at all you will get a good grade. Attendance is mandatory which is normal for college classes. Super sweet, understanding, and teaches well. What more could you ask for?

Lectures are interesting, but not super inspiring. Assignments are weighed heavily, but if you're good at writing and understanding texts well, or just take good in-class notes, you'll be fine. Attendance is mandatory, and there are in-class assignments that have to be done during lecture, so show up to class. It'll help your assignments anyway.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things
